parts.text:
Practitioner: Have you had any falls in the last year?
Interviewee: Oh. I've had a couple of wobbles.

Practitioner: How many times, and what happened the last one?
Interviewee: Three times since Christmas. The last one was in May. I slipped coming down the stairs.

Practitioner: And can I ask how much you drink in a week?
Interviewee: That's my own business, thank you. Put down that I'd rather not say.
